basics.name: Mira Okonkwo-Lind
basics.label: Frontend Engineer
basics.summary: Frontend engineer with 6 years building React and TypeScript products. Cares about accessibility, fast pages and design systems that teams actually adopt.

work.name: Fernhill Analytics
highlights: Led the move from a CRA app to Next.js with server-side rendering, cutting largest contentful paint from 3.9s to 1.7s.
Built a token-based design system in React and Storybook used by 4 product teams.
Raised WCAG 2.2 AA compliance across the dashboard and added axe checks to CI.
Mentored 3 junior engineers and ran weekly code review sessions.

work.name: Tidewater Health
highlights: Shipped a patient scheduling flow in React and Redux handling 40k bookings a month.
Wrote Jest and Playwright tests that brought checkout bugs found in production down by half.
Worked with designers in Figma and backend engineers on REST and GraphQL APIs.
